title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who seeks to plunge Gotham City into chaos.

title: Oppenheimer
description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.

title: Poor Things
description: The fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl enters a mysterious spirit world and must find a way to save her parents.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family gradually becomes entangled with a wealthy household, leading to unexpected consequences.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns that reality as he knows it is a simulation and joins a rebellion against its controllers.

title: Underworld
description: A vampire warrior becomes caught in a centuries-old war between vampires and Lycans.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy navigate love, social expectations, and misunderstandings in 19th-century England.

title: The Mask
description: A shy bank clerk discovers a magical mask that transforms him into a mischievous, cartoon-like character.

title: The Nutty Professor
description: A shy professor invents a formula that transforms him into a confident but unpredictable alter ego.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit begins a dangerous journey to destroy a powerful ring and prevent the Dark Lord from conquering Middle-earth.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description: The members of the Fellowship continue their separate journeys as war spreads across Middle-earth.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description: The final battle for Middle-earth begins as Frodo and Sam approach Mount Doom to destroy the One Ring.
